subtitle: Resurrection life, union with God, and the practice of spiritual authority

chapters.title: Unlearning What Was Handed Down
chapters.purpose: Open with the diagnosis: inherited custom and secondhand information replacing direct hearing from God.
chapters.summary: Direct hearing, bodily discipline, cultural food habits, tradition versus faith, ambition for long life.

chapters.title: Flesh and Bone: The Resurrection You Inherit
chapters.working_title: Flesh and Bone: The Resurrection You Inherit
chapters.purpose: Lay the central doctrinal correction about physical resurrection and restored sonship.
chapters.summary: Flesh and bone inheritance, sons of men becoming sons of God, Adam's failure and Christ's intercession, life already possessed.
section_titles: Spirits Have No Flesh and Bone
From Sons of Men to Sons of God
The Silence of Adam, the Prayer of Christ

chapters.title: Hebrews 2: Death Already Destroyed
chapters.purpose: Work the group exposition of Hebrews 2 and its consequences for preaching and fear.
chapters.summary: Live reading of Hebrews 2, translation dispute, African demonic emphasis, power already indwelling, accountability for the gospel preached.
section_titles: The Devil Men Still Boast Of

chapters.title: Priest, Prophet, King
chapters.purpose: Set out the sacred offices, the ordered priesthood, and the warnings attached to it.
chapters.summary: Shadow and fulfillment, three offices, universal versus ordered priesthood, Melchizedek, Malachi's warning, not despising the calling.
section_titles: Let No One Despise the Calling

chapters.title: Access, Not Achievement
chapters.purpose: Dismantle condition-based access to God: anointing, offering, worship, fasting.
chapters.summary: Activating the anointing, heart behind sacrifice, worship as fellowship, simplicity of receiving power, purpose and limits of fasting.
section_titles: Nothing Added to What He Said

chapters.title: That They May Be One
chapters.purpose: Make John 17 the structural spine: union, glory, preservation, and the critique of rapture-centered focus.
chapters.summary: Jesus' prayer, sanctification, unity and glory, honesty about one's stand, rapture critique, overflow of communion, the Holy Spirit as person, the promised dimension, sensitivity to spiritual levels.
section_titles: Be Factual About Where You Stand
Knowing the Spirit, Not Only the Gifts

chapters.title: Loved Exactly as Jesus Is Loved
chapters.working_title: Loved Exactly as Jesus Is Loved
chapters.purpose: Hold the unconditional love text against conditions preachers add, then show God's use of flawed people.
chapters.summary: John 17:23 on divine love, illegitimate conditions, goodness producing purity, imperfect biblical figures carrying great power.

chapters.title: Set Your Mind Above
chapters.purpose: Move from doctrine to the first practical discipline: fixing the mind on heavenly reality.
chapters.summary: Colossians 3 practice, Philippians 4:8 in ordinary life, mind as battlefield, completeness under the Head.

chapters.title: Laws You Gave Yourself
chapters.purpose: Expose self-imposed legalism from imitation and recover personal uniqueness before God.
chapters.summary: Imitation-born rules, individuality of spiritual experience, God's intimate knowledge, long process behind testimonies, historical cost of discipleship and coerced religion.
section_titles: He Knows How He Made You
The Real Cost of the Doctrine

chapters.title: Spirit, Soul and Body
chapters.purpose: Give the anatomy that the practice chapters depend on.
chapters.summary: Tripartite man, conscience, soul as hub, the dying that began at the Fall, growth into sonship, the devil's nature and contested identifications.

chapters.title: Reasonings and Strongholds
chapters.purpose: Distinguish natural knowledge from revelation and define the believer's real combat.
chapters.summary: Simplicity in Christ, flesh-and-blood knowledge, relevance to one's society, pastoral discernment in miracle settings, weapons and captive thoughts.
section_titles: The Simplicity That Is in Christ

chapters.title: Prayer Corrected
chapters.purpose: Reform prayer practice: tongues rightly used, correction received, hunger as the condition.
chapters.summary: Misused tongues, refreshment through tongues, the speaker's correction, sincerity without knowledge, hunger and thirst as anchor.
section_titles: He Told Me I Was Tired

chapters.title: The Renewed Mind and the Hidden Faculty
chapters.working_title: The Renewed Mind and the Hidden Faculty
chapters.purpose: Teach renewal of the mind and imagination as the method of lasting communion.
chapters.summary: Living sacrifice through renewal, the brain as instrument, imagination as God-given faculty, bringing Jesus into thought, trained meditation.
section_titles: The Power the Church Did Not Teach

chapters.title: Operating What You Have
chapters.purpose: Move into the exercise of power: abnormal faith, short prayer, hands, holiness, effortless gifts.
chapters.summary: Abnormal acts and short prayers, humility about untested doctrine, hands as doorways, holiness and simple faith, gifts flowing without struggle.

chapters.title: Grace Barely Touched
chapters.purpose: Show how much is already given and how believers testify to discovering it.
chapters.summary: Grace exceeding imagination, Moses contrasted with indwelling, retreat testimonies, healing already accomplished, progressive understanding, the sower as stages of one life.

chapters.title: Death as Gain
chapters.purpose: Resolve the fear-of-death thread opened in the resurrection chapters.
chapters.summary: No fear of death, fear as the devil's old strategy, death as gain lived rather than recited, peaceful departures.

chapters.title: Nothing by Chance
chapters.purpose: Make intentionality the organizing practice: speech, protection, and the responsibility of choice.
chapters.summary: Deliberate daily practice, aura of protection, speech correction, poverty as choice not design, balancing warning and promise.
section_titles: God Did Not Make Anyone Poor
The A Part and the B Part

chapters.title: Testimonies of Resurrection
chapters.purpose: Demonstrate the doctrine through resurrection accounts and the humility that must accompany them.
chapters.summary: The buried girl raised, activation of what God ordained, the young man raised, a prayer that did not succeed, the vessel's role.
section_titles: The Word That Could Not Fail

chapters.title: Out of the Eater
chapters.purpose: End with providence that reverses harm and the prophetic vision for the nation.
chapters.summary: Stolen Bible turned redemptive, loss treated as seed, declared exponential growth, vision of a transformed nation and a call to pray together.
